PostInvoiceStatusResponse.description: JSON:API formatted lifecycle change task response.

id.description: Id of the status change operation

statusCode.description: The unique e-invoice lifecycle status identifier (GUID)

statusAttributes.description:
Status-specific attributes. The presence and content depend on the statusCode:
- **InHand** (400...): no attributes
- **Approved** (500...): no attributes
- **PartiallyApproved** (600...): partiallyApprovedData array
- **Disputed** (700...): disputeData array
- **Suspended** (800...): suspendedData object
- **Completed** (140...): completedData array (optional)
- **Refused** (120...): rejectionData array
- **PaymentSent** (900...): paymentData array
- **PaymentReceived** (110...): paymentData array

statusCode.description: The unique e-invoice lifecycle status identifier (GUID)

statusAttributes.description:
Status-specific attributes. Structure depends on the status type:
- **partiallyApprovedData**: array of partially approved items with motif code, amounts, and currency
- **disputeData**: array of dispute items with reason code, notes, and requested action
- **suspendedData**: object with reason code and text
- **completedData**: array of completed items with field ID and corrected value
- **rejectionData**: array of rejection items with reason code and notes
- **paymentData**: array of payment items with net amount, VAT rate, and currency

status.description: The status member represents the HTTP status code associated with the problem.
